name: CustomTaskTemplate
description: Template task: uploads a file in chunks to an HTTP API and creates a version record. Replace with your own logic.
author: NemesLaszlo

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: API base URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the API the task talks to, for example `https://my-service.example.com`.

inputs.name: apiToken
inputs.label: API token
inputs.helpMarkDown: Bearer token used to call the API. Store it as a **secret pipeline variable** and reference it here as `$(MyApiToken)`. The task masks the value in logs.

inputs.name: resourceId
inputs.label: Resource ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Identifier of the resource (for example a product) the new version belongs to.

inputs.name: versionString
inputs.label: Version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Version string to create, for example `1.4.0`.

inputs.name: onExisting
inputs.label: If the version already exists
inputs.helpMarkDown: What to do when a version with the same version string already exists.

inputs.name: markActive
inputs.label: Mark the version as active
inputs.helpMarkDown: When checked the new version becomes the active (default) version.

inputs.name: primaryFilePath
inputs.label: Primary file
inputs.helpMarkDown: File to upload, for example the installer `.zip`. Relative paths are resolved against the working directory.

inputs.name: secondaryFilePath
inputs.label: Secondary file (optional)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional second file to upload, for example documentation. Leave empty to skip.

inputs.name: publishDate
inputs.label: Publish date (yyyy-MM-dd)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Date to record as the publish date. Defaults to today (UTC).

inputs.name: changelog
inputs.label: Changelog
inputs.helpMarkDown: One changelog entry per line. Empty lines are ignored.

inputs.name: chunkSizeMb
inputs.label: Upload chunk size (MB)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Large files are uploaded in chunks of this size. Must be a positive integer.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base directory for relative file paths. Defaults to `$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)`.

outputVariables.name: createdVersionId
outputVariables.description: Identifier of the version that was created, updated or found.
